acceptance: User-editable, per-search role scoring profiles configure dimensions and thresholds without occupation-specific code changes.
Optional specialized signals carry explicit provenance.
Explanations identify the selected scoring profile and each signal contribution.
Soft profile preferences remain advisory and cannot alter hard eligibility rules.
Scheduled searches without a role profile preserve the legacy default score, components, eligibility, excluded-job state, and idempotent match history.
